0022600218.text: The Cavaliers (5-6) are 2nd in the Central, 2.5 games back, and 7th in the East, having lost their last two games and gone 1-4 on the road, and Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow) are both out. The Knicks (5-4) are 3rd in the Atlantic, 3 games back, and 5th in the East, riding a three-game winning streak, and Josh Hart is out with an illness. Cleveland trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 109-97 loss in Cleveland on November 7, and it lost 1-2 to New York in the 2025-26 regular season and 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs.
